Voxy interoperation references
Upstream: https://github.com/MCRcortex/voxy
License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (project remains GPL-3.0-or-later).

PreparedColumn implements registry-independent cells and mip selection compatible with Voxy's
Mapper, Mipper and WorldVoxilizedSectionMipper. NativeVoxy uses the upstream WorldUpdater API
reflectively and checks the cell layout and mip count. It resolves all block and biome mappings
through the active client engine; remote numeric mapping IDs are never trusted.

Sources consulted:
https://github.com/MCRcortex/voxy/blob/dev/src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/other/Mipper.java
https://github.com/MCRcortex/voxy/blob/dev/src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/other/Mapper.java
https://github.com/MCRcortex/voxy/blob/dev/src/main/java/me/cortex/voxy/common/world/WorldUpdater.java
No Voxy jar or compiled upstream classes are bundled in LodClient or LodServer.
